metrics.recommendation: Stage only SP500 short-only containment; make no current live mutation and claim no profitability improvement.
metrics.why_now: The first exact V58 SP500 long closed at -4.873255 USD after 49.1013 bps of peak giveback. Historical development, untouched validation, and stress were negative on both sides. Two exact prior live shorts closed +6.73181 USD combined, but both used the 24-hour fallback and the sample is too small to establish edge. A third short is open and protected.
metrics.observed_problem: Bidirectional authority exposes capital to a long side with one negative exact lifecycle and negative comparable historical evidence, while aggregate SP500 live evidence remains largest-winner dependent.
metrics.applicable_regime: Exact v3 breakout-pressure SP500 route only. The proposal is authority containment, not a claim about general SP500 regimes or a new entry mechanism.
alternatives: Keep V58 bidirectional authority unchanged after the open short resolves
Add a fixed target or lower profit-lock activation
metrics.proposed_live_change: Only at a future verified flat and order-free boundary, remove SP500 long execution authority. Preserve all eight assets, ten-position capacity, both-side observation telemetry, the exact short route, and every sizing, stop, profit-lock, opposite-intent, and maximum-hold parameter.
metrics.expected_upside: Avoid future exposure to the currently unsupported long side while retaining causal short-side learning. No return forecast or short-side profitability claim is supported.

success_metrics.economic_review_boundary: Review after three additional independent shorts or 30 calendar days, whichever comes first
success_metrics.economic: Exact after-cost net PnL above zero, profit factor above one, and net PnL excluding the largest winner above zero
success_metrics.technical: Zero runtime faults, zero venue-ledger divergence, exactly one owned protective stop per open position, and no fingerprint/direction/exit/sizing/TUI drift
success_metrics.gate_semantics: Review metrics are reported evidence, not hidden automatic execution gates

rollback_triggers.technical: Any fingerprint, execution-direction, exit, sizing, ledger, stop, preflight, or TUI mismatch blocks or rolls back the candidate
rollback_triggers.economic: Non-positive or largest-winner-dependent evidence prompts an explicit human decision; it does not create an undeclared automatic gate

metrics.approval_state: Deferred. No live cutover approval is requested while SP500 remains open; request operation-specific approval only after a verified flat and order-free boundary.
